topics.label: Proposed drone-refilled seedling reservoir
topics.description: User proposal from the 10 November 2026 chat: plant nursery stock together with a tube or local reservoir, then have a drone visit and refill it. The suggested 0.5 L every couple of days is an assumed design scenario; species, soil, climate, stock size and exact interval are unspecified. Reviewed sources establish separate components: buried pipe/sleeve delivery, passive reservoirs, small manually piloted water-payload tests, an indoor funnel invention, and larger agricultural spray aircraft. Their combination has not been validated in the reviewed evidence. A fill opening, transferred-volume measurement, overflow/loss control and a suitable soil outlet must work together. As a capacity-only calculation, 40 L divided by an assumed 0.5 L gives 80 fills before reserves, losses, travel and time constraints; it is not measured plants per flight or per hour. Component citations support this curated concept, not the assumed dose or an empirical system outcome.
